---
title: "Cropland & pasture"
subtitle: "Agricultural land in LandSHIFT and its role for natural ecosystem loss"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/setup.R")

lu <- landuse %>%
  filter(iso3 %in% valid_iso3) %>%
  left_join(country_labels, by = "iso3") %>%
  mutate(extensive_km2 = pmax(graze_km2 - pasture_int_km2, 0))

latest_year <- max(lu$year, na.rm = TRUE)
```

Agricultural land in BF-NEE consists of **cropland** (irrigated + rainfed) and
**intensive pasture**. A cell's grazing land counts as intensive if its stocking
density is above the country mean of the grazing land (fixed per country, 1995–2015).
Extensive grazing stays part of the natural ecosystem cover ([method](method.qmd#pasture)).

## Agricultural land over time

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4.6
g <- lu %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(`Cropland` = sum(cropland_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
            `Intensive pasture` = sum(pasture_int_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
            `Extensive grazing (natural)` = sum(extensive_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(-year, names_to = "type", values_to = "km2") %>%
  mutate(type = factor(type, levels = c("Cropland", "Intensive pasture", "Extensive grazing (natural)")))

p <- ggplot(g, aes(factor(year), km2, fill = type,
                   text = paste0(type, "<br>", year, ": ", fmt_km2(km2)))) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = bf_ink$surface, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(basis_colors, "Extensive grazing (natural)" = bf_ink$other), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = fmt_area, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(title = "LandSHIFT agricultural land and grazing",
       subtitle = "Sum over all valid producing countries · only cropland and intensive pasture are agricultural land",
       x = NULL, y = "Area (km²)")

bf_interactive(p)
```

## Expansion of cropland and pasture

Net agricultural expansion per grid cell, split into cropland and pasture
(the quantity that limits the attributed loss).

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4.4
ex <- global_period %>%
  select(period, `Cropland` = agri_gain_cropland_km2, `Intensive pasture` = agri_gain_pasture_km2) %>%
  pivot_longer(-period, names_to = "basis", values_to = "km2") %>%
  group_by(period) %>% mutate(share = km2 / sum(km2)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basis = factor(basis, levels = names(basis_colors)))

p <- ggplot(ex, aes(period, km2, fill = basis,
                    text = paste0(basis, "<br>", period, ": +", fmt_km2(km2), " (", fmt_pct(share), ")"))) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = bf_ink$surface, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = basis_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = fmt_area, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(title = "Agricultural expansion by land use",
       x = NULL, y = "Area increase (km²)")

bf_interactive(p)
```

## How intensive is grazing?

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4
reg <- lu %>%
  filter(year == latest_year) %>%
  group_by(continent) %>%
  summarise(share = sum(pasture_int_km2, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(graze_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
            graze_km2 = sum(graze_km2, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(is.finite(share), graze_km2 > 0) %>%
  mutate(continent = forcats::fct_reorder(continent, share))

ggplot(reg, aes(share, continent, fill = continent)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65) +
  geom_text(aes(label = fmt_pct(share)), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.4, colour = bf_ink$secondary) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = continent_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = fmt_pct, limits = c(0, 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(title = paste("Share of grazing land classified as intensive,", latest_year),
       subtitle = "Grazing area with a stocking density above the country mean",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bfnee(grid = "x")
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5.6
thr <- lu %>%
  filter(year == latest_year, is.finite(stocking_threshold_lu_per_ha), graze_km2 > 0) %>%
  slice_max(graze_km2, n = 25) %>%
  mutate(country_name = forcats::fct_reorder(country_name, stocking_threshold_lu_per_ha))

p <- ggplot(thr, aes(stocking_threshold_lu_per_ha, country_name, colour = continent,
                     text = paste0("<b>", country_name, "</b><br>Threshold: ",
                                   signif(stocking_threshold_lu_per_ha, 3), " LU/ha<br>Grazing land: ",
                                   fmt_km2(graze_km2), "<br>Intensive: ", fmt_pct(share_graze_intensive)))) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = stocking_threshold_lu_per_ha, yend = country_name),
               colour = bf_ink$grid, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = continent_colors, name = NULL) +
  labs(title = "Stocking-rate threshold of the 25 largest grazing countries",
       subtitle = "Mean stocking density of the grazing land, 1995–2015",
       x = "Threshold (livestock units per ha)", y = NULL) +
  theme_bfnee(grid = "x")

bf_interactive(p)
```

## Where is pasture expansion linked to ecosystem loss?

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5.6
pc <- ct %>%
  filter(period == latest_period) %>%
  transmute(country_name, continent, `Cropland` = loss_cropland_km2,
            `Intensive pasture` = loss_pasture_km2, total = loss_constrained_km2) %>%
  slice_max(total, n = 15) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(`Cropland`, `Intensive pasture`), names_to = "basis", values_to = "km2") %>%
  mutate(country_name = forcats::fct_reorder(country_name, total),
         basis = factor(basis, levels = names(basis_colors)))

ggplot(pc, aes(km2, country_name, fill = basis)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = bf_ink$surface, linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = basis_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = fmt_area, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(title = paste("Agriculture-constrained loss by land use,", latest_period),
       subtitle = "15 countries with the largest constrained loss",
       x = "Area (km²)", y = NULL) +
  theme_bfnee(grid = "x")
```

## Table

```{r}
lu %>%
  filter(year == latest_year) %>%
  transmute(ISO3 = iso3, Country = country_name, Region = continent,
            `Threshold (LU/ha)` = stocking_threshold_lu_per_ha,
            `Cropland (km²)` = cropland_km2,
            `Grazing land (km²)` = graze_km2,
            `Intensive pasture (km²)` = pasture_int_km2,
            `Share intensive` = share_graze_intensive) %>%
  arrange(desc(`Intensive pasture (km²)`)) %>%
  round_df(2) %>%
  bf_table()
```
